title: Qlik Sense App Response Time p95
app: Qlik Sense logs via UF; QRS API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy status="200"
| eval dur_s=round(response_time_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by app_name
| where p95_s>8
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile response time for each app in Qlik Sense and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Qlik Sense apps by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Qlik Sense timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest apps with their owners.
visualization: Table of app by p95 response time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Qlik Sense so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
